title: Kuro voice, more relaxed
question: Which of these is Kuro, relaxed and a little seductive?

options.label: 0. Current (kuro-design)
options.note: Today's voice, for comparison. Composed, even, precise.

options.label: a. Relaxed and warm
options.note: Relaxed, low, unhurried, warm, a smile in the voice. Reference about 255 Hz (current about 286). Proposed VOICE.md wording if picked: Kuro. Relaxed and warm, low and unhurried, with a smile in her voice. Courteous at the desk without hurrying. A tease comes easily and kindly; she lets Eric notice it. No gushing or pet names.

options.label: b. Relaxed, husky
options.note: Relaxed with a husky, slightly breathy low register. Lowest of the five: about 212 Hz. Proposed VOICE.md wording if picked: Kuro. Relaxed, low and a little husky, slightly breathy, warm. Courteous at the desk, never hurried. A tease is quiet and smoky; she lets Eric notice it. No gushing or pet names.

options.label: c. Lazy, teasing
options.note: Lazy, teasing, amused, languid, slow vowels. Reference about 298 Hz. Proposed VOICE.md wording if picked: Kuro. Lazy and amused, unhurried, a little languid. Courteous at the desk but plainly enjoying Eric. She teases openly in a warm, easy voice and lets a line trail off. No gushing or pet names.

options.label: d. Smooth, intimate
options.note: Smooth, intimate, low and slow, velvety with a soft breathy edge. The most seductive of the four. Reference about 264 Hz. Proposed VOICE.md wording if picked: Kuro. Smooth, low and slow, close and intimate, with a soft breathy edge. Courteous at the desk, composed, never hurried. She leaves a little silence after a line on purpose. No gushing or pet names.

decision: Voice b is Kuro's voice (live, 9 clips re-voiced); voice a is kept as a reserved warm voice.
